# Boblo (https://www.boblo.ir)

> Boblo is a modern, full-stack social media platform built for real-time microblogging, post sharing, user interactions, and profile customisation.

## Key Features
- **Public Timeline**: Read community tweets, likes, retweets, and interactions in real time.
- **User Profiles**: Custom user handles, avatars, cover images, and bio details (`https://www.boblo.ir/[username]`).
- **Tweet Sharing**: Post, edit, and reply to tweets (`https://www.boblo.ir/tweet/[tweetId]`).
- **Authentication**: Secure passwordless and credential-based account management (`https://www.boblo.ir/auth`).

## Primary Public Routes
- Home Feed: `https://www.boblo.ir/`
- User Profiles: `https://www.boblo.ir/[username]`
- Individual Tweets: `https://www.boblo.ir/tweet/[tweetId]`
- Authentication & Login: `https://www.boblo.ir/auth`

## Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, Server Actions)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS & Base UI
